name: CIFAR-100
description: The CIFAR-100 dataset consists of 60,000 32x32 colour images across 100 fine-grained classes grouped into 20 coarse superclasses. Each class contains 600 images (500 training images and 100 test images), collected by Alex Krizhevsky, Vinod Nair, and Geoffrey Hinton.
